content.title: Hybrid Anime Title Relay | Character Anchor, Number Cards, City Montage
content.summary: A rooftop courier links portrait, number, tram, street and route-map modules into NIGHT SHIFT. Preserve the five causal invariants, stable spatial anchors and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One identity system anchors flat and spatial modules. + Each module introduces one title or number field. + Actions and occlusions motivate every handoff. + The city module preserves character anchors. + The final card consolidates the repeated portrait, number and title.
quick_start.recommended_input: Open an original adult rooftop courier portrait beside the exact red-black title NIGHT SHIFT. Move the courier into a cobalt tram platform and let one passing carriage wipe into a street-running action. Consolidate the same portrait, 07 and exact title NIGHT SHIFT into a stable final card.
required_anchors: One identity system anchors flat and spatial modules.
Each module introduces one title or number field.
The city module preserves character anchors.
The final card consolidates the repeated portrait, number and title.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A rooftop courier links portrait, number, tram, street and route-map modules into NIGHT SHIFT. Preserve the five causal invariants, stable spatial anchors and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.
